title: Marvel Collector Boxex
text: These are for my son who loves super heroes. He had been getting Legion of Collectors but these were discontinued and I was looking for something with which to replace it. This is it. He has received one box and he loved the contents. I do like that these boxes will say if there will be a shirt included. I can also find out from Amazon when the box is going to ship. This information is available weeks in advance. Plus the boxes have been a bit less cost wise. I love that.
label: positive
